# Your account and your privacy

- If your organization already gives you a Claude seat, use that.
- Otherwise, each of you uses your own individual Claude Pro account. You set it up, it belongs to you, and it stays yours after the program.
- Wells Fargo covers your Claude Pro account for six months. Rachel Bruce from RW Institute emails you about how the payment reaches you. Choose the monthly plan, not the annual one.
- Nobody at RW Institute or PCI can see your chats or files.
- When the six months end, your Claude subscription keeps charging your card each month until you cancel it. Decide before then whether you want to keep paying for it yourself.
- Clients, donors, volunteers and anyone you serve never go into Claude or your AI-Labs folder, and neither do health or case details. Staff names in your everyday writing are fine.
- You decide whether your chats are used to train Claude's models, with the model-training setting in Claude's privacy settings. We recommend turning it off, and we'll set it together in Lab 1.
